enrichment.headline: Sets aside up to $75,000 in one-time funds to carry out Measure QQ (youth voting)
enrichment.summary: The Board adopts a resolution allocating up to $75,000 in one-time general purpose funds to support putting Measure QQ into effect. The item's title identifies Measure QQ as the youth voting measure. The official text does not say how the money will be spent.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Measure QQ - Youth Voting - Chief Governance Officer

enrichment.headline: Ratifies a Board President appointment to the Measure N College and Career Readiness Commission
enrichment.summary: The Board approves the Board President's appointment of a new member to the Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission. The appointment takes effect December 2, 2021, and fills an unexpired term ending January 31, 2023. No money is involved.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Appointment - Marc Tafolla, Member, Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission - President, Board of Education

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $49,000 for Ojo Technology security camera maintenance at various sites, not competitively bid
enrichment.summary: Ojo Technology of Fremont will maintain security camera systems at various district sites on a time-and-materials basis, including minor repairs. The title says the agreement was noncompetitively bid. Work was scheduled to start October 18, 2021, before the Board's vote, and run until January 31, 2022. It is paid from Measure J bond funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement for Maintenance – Noncompetitively Bid – Ojo Technology - Various Sites Security Camera Maintenance Support Project –– Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $7,260 for ACC Environmental asbestos testing at Claremont Middle School
enrichment.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants will do a limited asbestos survey and lead sampling screening, with up to 85 asbestos samples sent to a lab, and write a report for the Claremont Middle School Multipurpose Room Project. The $7,260 limit includes a $660 contingency fee. Work runs December 2, 2021 to January 31, 2022, paid from Measure J bond funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – ACC Environmental Consultants, Inc. – Claremont Middle School Multi-Purpose Room Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Approves $418,550 for KDI Group construction inspector services on Claremont Middle School project
enrichment.summary: KDI Group, Inc. will provide Inspector of Record services for construction work on the Claremont Middle School Multi-Purpose Room Project, including work needing Division of the State Architect approval. The $418,550 amount includes a $38,050 contingency fee. Work runs December 2, 2021 to October 31, 2023, paid from Measure J bond funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement for Inspector of Record Services for Construction – KDI Group, Inc. – Claremont Middle School Multi-purpose Room Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $6,200 for KW Engineering green-building paperwork on the Madison Park Academy expansion
enrichment.summary: KW Engineering will do non-design work to complete the Collaborative for High Performance Schools (CHPS) requirements for the Madison Park Academy Site Expansion Project, including a trend review, site walk, final report updates and help with the CHPS submittal. The $6,200 limit includes a $1,000 contingency fee. Work started November 18, 2021, before Board approval, and runs to June 30, 2022.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Agreement for Engineering Services – KW Engineering – Madison Park Academy Expansion Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Adds $2,800 to Terraphase Engineering's agreement for the Laurel Child Development Center project
enrichment.summary: This amendment pays Terraphase Engineering for extra work outside its original scope: switching the drilling method to follow the district's Project Labor Agreement and an extra trip to meet the utility locator for PG&E. It raises the agreement's cap from $24,929 to $27,729. All other terms stay the same.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: Amendment No. 1, Engineering Service Agreement - Terraphase Engineering, Inc. - Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $21,985 for Millennium Consulting hazardous-materials testing at Laurel child care center
enrichment.summary: Millennium Consulting Associates will test samples of suspected hazardous materials in a certified lab, prepare a survey report and specifications, monitor the air during removal, and write final clearance and close-out reports for the Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project. The $21,985 limit includes a $4,000 contingency fee. Work started November 8, 2021, before Board approval, and is scheduled to last until December 16, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – Millennium Consulting Associates – Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
